purpose: Independent expected labels for a finite synthetic held-out live evaluation. These are not production matchmaking rules or live proof.

cases.left: I am seeking a developer relations role. I have written SDK tutorials and supported developer communities for three years. I want an initial 20-minute discussion about a remote full-time opportunity.
cases.right: I recruit developer advocates for our SDK team. The role involves technical education and community support, and we require two years of relevant experience. This is a remote full-time role; I offer an initial 20-minute role discussion.

cases.left: I need one 20-minute review of the keyboard navigation in my React form. I can bring the prototype and a reproducible focus-order issue. I am asking for a one-off volunteer review.
cases.right: I offer one 20-minute volunteer review of a React form for keyboard accessibility. I have implemented focus management and screen-reader support in React applications. I want to help another builder fix a concrete navigation issue; no reciprocal work is required.

cases.left: I want a technical cofounder for an open-source water-quality sensor dashboard. I bring sensor deployment experience and customer interviews. I can work ten hours a week on a four-week validation project before discussing a longer-term partnership.
cases.right: I seek a domain cofounder for an open-source water-quality sensor dashboard. I bring full-stack engineering and data visualization. I can commit ten hours a week to a four-week validation project, then discuss whether a longer-term partnership makes sense.
